title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description: Enclustra is an innovative, dynamic and growing company with headquarters in Zurich, Switzerland, and offices worldwide. We develop a product portfolio of FPGA-based electronic modules and FPGA-optimized IP solutions for industrial customers and research organizations. In parallel, we provide leading engineering services in FPGA system design, and in development of high-speed hardware, FPGA firmware and embedded software. To strengthen our dynamic team in Singapore, we are looking for a new: Senior FPGA/SoC Embedded Software Engineer Responsibilities: Design and develop embedded Linux BSPs and reference designs for our FPGA/SoC products Perform bring-ups of new products and custom boards and debug complex systems Design production tests for new products based on our test suite Design, specification, and implementation of embedded solutions Support our customers in the successful deployment of our products Lead and own design and code reviews and mentor/support junior engineers Contribute to standards and libraries and hold workshops and trainings Requirements: Degree (PhD/MSc/BSc) in electrical engineering or equivalent At least 5 years of practical experience with some embedded technologies (FPGA/SoC/CPU/MPU, Linux/RTOS, Security, PCIe, Ethernet, USB), embedded software (C/C++) development and unit testing Familiarity with the development of BSPs for embedded operating systems. Experience with FPGA tools (AMD Xilinx Vivado, Intel Quartus or Microchip) Demonstrates knowledge of industry best practices and trends Collaborative, reliable and solution-oriented individual Accountable personality that needs little direction with a structured and pragmatic working style Effective communication skills and ability to interact across different levels and regions Fluency in English Singaporean Citizen or PR only Enclustra offers you an interesting job in an exciting work environment with lots of creative freedom. At Enclustra you will be part of a motivated international team of colleagues from more than 20 nations. Our company is defined by an open and inclusive working culture, unbureaucratic decision-making, flexible working structure and a dedication to employee well-being
industries: Computer Hardware, Appliances, Electrical, and Electronics Manufacturing, and Retail Appliances, Electrical, and Electronic Equipment
